posts.title: Rewilded SF
posts.description: Epistemic Status: Fictional In the Redwood grove just north of the de Young, there are three hundred-foot Redwoods with auto-belays nailed to the trunk sixty feet up. One is a 5.4 with climbable branches the whole way, another a 5.10a with brown footholds discreetly nailed into the tree, and the third a 5.12a on which you have to hand-jam in cracks in the bark. On Sundays there’s a water polo game

posts.title: Global Pausers
posts.description: In San Francisco it’s no longer crazy to propose that we’ll all die in a year or two because of misaligned AI. If more people believed this, what would the world look like? [1] California passes legislation requiring a safety framework for new model releases. The AG opens a case against OpenAI for insufficient disclosures following the Hugging Face Incident. posts.title: Magic Rocks
posts.description: Godric got into the flying carriage and headed back to his castle. He took his crystal ball from his pantaloons, shook it, and began chatting with his mother. They talked face to face, though she lived a month’s ride away. Godric’s mother asked him about the new girl he was seeing.
